nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Truth Juice Gentle Glow Daily Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report the cleanser helped clear breakouts and reduce acne scars, though one notes it is hard to rinse off completely.
segments.dry: Some reviewers describe the product as drying and tightening on dry skin, leaving it flaky or reliant on facial oils afterward, while a lifelong dry/flaky-skin user reports it as the only cleanser that hasn't dried him out.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin reports no redness, dryness, or irritation and calls vitamin C washes her best match.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation, breakouts, or dryness and call it gentle, while others describe burning, swelling, redness, flaking, or severe breakouts, with one warning it is not suited for sensitive skin.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 40s reports her skin has never looked better, and a 58-year-old fair-skinned reviewer reports the cleanser was drying and left her skin tight and uncomfortable.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report brighter, glowing complexions and one mentions diminished fine lines; a reviewer in her 40s says her skin has never looked better.
concerns.dehydration: Opinions are split: many reviewers report the cleanser does not dry out or tighten skin and leaves it soft, while several others report significant dryness, tightness, flaking, or needing facial oils afterward.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness after use, but a few describe new redness, flaking, or swollen, burned-looking skin after just a few uses.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe burning, swelling, shell-like or damaged-feeling skin lasting days, while others with sensitive or reactive skin report the cleanser is gentle and caused no reaction.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report visible brightening and diminished dark spots or dullness after use, describing a boost in radiance and clearer skin tone.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin report clearer skin, reduced breakouts, and faded acne scars; one reviewer reports the opposite, a bad breakout that persisted for days after a single use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the cleanser made her skin become oily despite also feeling dry, while acne-prone/oily-skin reviewers otherwise report no complaints about oiliness.

extraits.texte: I was so excited to try this face wash but after just a week my skin went from great to horrible over night. I woke up to horrible red sore bumps on my checks an under eyes an my face was so dry . I wasn' sure if it was the face wash but was pretty sure due to that was the only new thing I was trying so I tried the face wash again after the red blemishes got smaller an it's been 2 weeks an the red blemishes are gone but my face is so drying. I have never experienced this issue in my life I have to keep facial oils on my face throughout the day to make my face feel hydrated it's terrible. So beware I never had really sensitive skin either just a few breakouts throughout the year.

Bought this last week and used it two times before getting terrible swollen eyes, the whole area lookes dry and burned with shell-like eyelids. I had a presentation at work over Teams and people were shocked. This is 6 days ago and it's still there. Later I have read reveiws of many others experiencing the same. I am not sensitive or allergic to anything. This is my first make up/skin care review ever, but I find it important to warn other potential users

extraits.titre: Would not recommend for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I was told this was the best cruelty free cleanser in store for sensitive skin (when asked for any alternatives, this was assured to me as the only option for sensitive skin). The cleanser is bright orange (not sure what kind of dyes used but that is usually a red flag for sensitive skin). I do not get acne, just a mild breakout from skin products that will disappear in a day once I discontinue use, but this product made my skin break out so bad within one day that not even pimple patches are making it go away days after discontinuing, which has never happened to me before. It may be totally fine for normal skin, but I strongly recommend avoiding this cleanser if you have sensitive skin.

I was nervous to use this on my acne prone, oily skin, especially with an already present breakout. At first, I couldn't tell if it was making the breakout worst or simply purging because of the PHA in it. Thankfully, it was the latter and my face has since cleared up. It's noticeably helped lessen my acne scars, has helped lessen any breakouts, and it makes my skin feel baby soft! Another plus is you don't need to apply much of it so one bottle is guaranteed to last me months. The only complaint I have about it is that it is incredibly hard to wash off and I can never tell if it's fully off or if some residue is still left over.

extraits.titre: Only product I'll ever use for my face!!
extraits.texte: I am a man and have always and I mean always suffered from flaky, dry skin for my entire life. I've tried just about any product always with the same consequences, more dry flaky, inflammed skin. My sister recommended this, and after 18 plus years of misery I found something that works! I have stopped experimenting with treatments, and I feel confident that this product wont dry up my skin.
Absolutely love the smell of this! So far I'm loving this - no redness, dryness, or irritation from using this. I have combination acne prone skin and vitamin c washes tend to be my best frien.
I love this face cleaner. My face has never looked better in my 40s. Highly recommend!
